init_profiler_scheduler: init the torch or v2 profiler on a scheduler instance with tensor parallel rank and GPU ID
configure_scheduler_profile: configure profiling parameters including output directory, step counts, activities, and stage-based profiling
start_scheduler_profiler: start the torch profiler with CPU/GPU/XPU activities and optional memory or CUDA profiler tracing
stop_scheduler_profiler: stop profiling, export chrome trace files, and optionally merge multi-rank profile traces
route_scheduler_profile_request: route a profile request to init_profile or start_profile for START_PROFILE type or stop_profile otherwise
